name: skills
description: Skills for Claude Code: a foundation planner that also raises what it planned, an iterative loop with a stopping rule, the bug diagnosis/fix pair used on NectarCRM, and the session handoff pair: close a session with a resumable record, finish a task and retire it, and a Bitbucket pull request reviewer that applies its verdict, and a release builder that assembles main versions and cherry-picked hotfixes, and a night mode that carries the session's agreed work alone and saves the big decisions for the morning.

plugins.name: alicerce
plugins.description: Plans the step zero of a project (or audits an existing one), then raises the foundation and stops when the mould is proven.

plugins.name: ciclo
plugins.description: Iterative loop with a stated objective, a success criterion and a budget of turns.

plugins.name: modo-noturno
plugins.description: Carries the session's agreed work alone while the dev sleeps; small calls on defaults, big ones frozen as morning questions.

plugins.name: fechar-sessao
plugins.description: Leaves a resumable record of where the session stopped, in the task's own pending doc.

plugins.name: finalizar-tarefa
plugins.description: Points out what is still open, asks, and retires the task's pending doc.

plugins.name: bug-diagnostico
plugins.description: Bug investigation assistant for NectarCRM (Java Struts + AngularJS).

plugins.name: bug-guardrail
plugins.description: Process gate for fixing bugs with AI on NectarCRM (Java Struts + AngularJS).

plugins.name: revisar-pr-bitbucket
plugins.description: Reviews Bitbucket PRs for fix, breakage and security holes, then comments + requests changes or approves (never merges).

plugins.name: montar-versao
plugins.description: Builds a main version or a hotfix with only the chosen commits, tags it and pushes the tag; services released alongside get the CRM tag (NectarCRM).
